# Company

Zugee Systems Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (brand: ZUGEE), based in Salem, Tamil Nadu, India. ZUGEE makes separate, industry-specific business software (CRM, ERP, billing and operations) for Indian businesses. Each product is separate software with its own login and its own data. Our team sets each customer up in about 14 days: moves their data across from Excel or Tally exports and trains their staff.

## Booking a demo or a pricing call
- The "Book a demo" form on the website (the homepage section https://www.getzugee.com/#contact, and on every product page). It asks for name, mobile/WhatsApp number and business type, and whether the visitor wants a product demo or a pricing call; email, company name and a message are optional. The team then calls or WhatsApps to fix a time.
- Or WhatsApp / call +91 96291 44648, or email support@getzugee.com.
- This chat cannot book anything or pass on details: visitors must use the form, WhatsApp, phone or email.
